note: Attacker-controlled GNU hash section size (13, not a multiple of the 4-byte word) and raw section bytes are passed to the xlate conversion function elf_cvt_gnuhash without a multiple-of-record-size check.
After converting 3 full 32-bit words of the 13-byte input, remaining len is 1 < 4 so the function returns early, leaving dest byte 12 uninitialized instead of copying the trailing partial byte.
The converted buffer that still has its uninitialized tail byte is exposed as the section Elf_Data returned by elf_getdata.
The GNU 'ZLIB' magic check on the converted data passes (first word was initialized), so decompression proceeds with the partially-initialized buffer.
buf_in = data->d_buf + 12 points exactly at the single uninitialized tail byte (d_size 13, hsize 12).
zlib inflate consumes the size_in (1) bytes at buf_in, reading the uninitialized tail byte and triggering MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value.
